function allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns (uint256)
function transfer(address to, uint256 value) returns (bool)
function approve(address spender, uint256 value) returns (bool)
function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) returns (bool)
function epochs(uint256 epoch) view returns (uint256 blockNumber, uint256 totalReward, uint256 minerCount, uint256 claimedCount, uint256 timestamp)
function miner_claimed_epochs(address miner, uint256 epoch) view returns (bool)
function pendingProofs(address miner) view returns (bytes solution, uint256 timestamp, bool claimed)
event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)
event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value)
event Mining(address indexed miner, uint256 reward, bytes solution)
event ProofSubmitted(address indexed miner, uint256 indexed epoch, bytes32 indexed solutionHash)
event RewardClaimed(address indexed miner, uint256 indexed epoch, uint256 amount)
event EpochTransition(uint256 indexed oldEpoch, uint256 indexed newEpoch, uint256 totalReward, uint256 minerCount)
event DifficultyAdjusted(uint256 oldDifficulty, uint256 newDifficulty, uint256 blockNumber)
event ChallengeGenerated(bytes32 indexed newChallenge, uint256 blockNumber)
